top_signals.title: Brent Oil Hits $100 a Barrel for the First Time Since July 24
top_signals.summary: Brent oil topped $100 a barrel for the first time since July, as attacks between the US and Iran and a recovery in Chinese oil buying propel the global crude benchmark higher.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Commodities Bull Market Is Underpriced: 3-Minutes MLIV
top_signals.summary: Anna Edwards, Tom Mackenzie and Mark Cudmore break down today's key themes for analysts and investors on "Bloomberg: The Opening Trade."  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Majid Al Futtaim Earnings Rise in 'Challenging' Market
top_signals.summary: Dubai-based Majid Al Futtaim, which owns shopping malls, residential communities and retail businesses, reported record first-half EBITDA of 2.5 billion dirhams ($681 million). CEO Ahmed Galal Ismail told Bloomberg's Abeer Abu Omar that the conglomerate is navigating a "challenging operating environment," particularly in hospitality and non-food retail. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Google to invest $15 billion into AI infrastructure in Finland in biggest ever Europe investment
top_signals.summary: Google on Wednesday said it would invest 13 billion euros ($15.1 billion) into AI infrastructure in Finland, marking the tech giant's largest single investment in Europe.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
